description: Land Acquisition - Kekilla Mandiya, Hikkaduwa D/S Division, Galle District and Deewilla, Yatawattha D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content contains multiple declarations under Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes. It provides detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, locations, and survey information. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, including specific lot numbers, measurements in hectares, boundary descriptions, and property claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
